violations.why: Main reads the global at line 25 to pass it as an argument, and the ISR can write 0 before main re-reads it at line 35. The range check was made on a stale value.
The increment at line 35 is a non-atomic read-modify-write. The ISR can write 0 between its read and its write, and the write-back then overwrites the ISR's value with the stale value plus 1.
